We just released the first update to demo (and most of changes were ported to the full game simultaneously too). events.title: "Gun Massacre: The First Shot" Demo is OUT NOW!
events.summary: "Gun Massacre: The First Shot" Demo is OUT NOW! Explore the Mansion, Solve the Puzzles and get the gun in your hands for the first time. Send your feedback/bug reports anywhere you can reach us (Discord, YouTube, Steam). We're waiting for your opinions. For detailed description check out our previous post with Demo's Q&A!

events.title: GUN MASSACRE DEMO "THE FIRST SHOT" LAUNCHES ON SEPTEMBER 18TH
events.summary: "Step in this eerie Mansion for the first time, explore the possessions of your Grandfather who mysteriously passed away, solve puzzles and in the end make your first shot to freedom. If you notice something strange in the shadows, that's on you." Q&A: How long will the demo be?Around 30 minutes, but this fully depends on how quick you are at solving puzzles and going through the story!Will there be a FOV Slider?Yes! events.title: Gun Massacre - June Devlog
events.summary: Hello all loyal "Gun Massacre" Followers, another month went away and we want to show you the little progress we made!- Item storage system is done and dusted. No more troubles with overflowed Inventory and full freedom. For extreme cases, you also can swap items in the storage to get rid of not needed item and have useful one right in your hands immediately.- 2 more puzzles were made for the game. events.title: Gun Massacre - 1 Month After
events.summary: Month ago we published the Steam page for our game "Gun Massacre" - A Survival Horror game heavily inspired by Resident Evil. Since then we were working on expanding the game's mechanics, puzzles and core gameplay.
